Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Gustave Courbet's birth date was October 6, 1819, instead of June 10, 1819. This error occurred because the Planner misinterpreted the numeric form "10/06/1819" in the metadata of the Institut Gustave Courbet page. The metadata uses the European date format (DD/MM/YYYY), which represents June 10, 1819, but the Planner mistakenly standardized it to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), interpreting it as October 6, 1819. This critical misinterpretation led to the incorrect final answer.
